questions.subject: MICROECONOMICS
questions.stem: In a clinician's note on a drug market, income elasticity measures how quantity demanded responds to income; what is its formula?

options.text: Percent change in quantity over percent change in income
Percent change in price over percent change in quantity
Percent change in income over percent change in price
Change in revenue over change in income

questions.explanation: Income elasticity is percent change in quantity demanded divided by percent change in income. Sign indicates normal or inferior.
questions.hint: Quantity response to income.

questions.subject: MICROECONOMICS
questions.stem: In a clinician's note, at price 10 and quantity 20, dQ/dP=-2. What is point price elasticity?

questions.hint: Multiply derivative by P over Q.
